narrationTexts: Confirms the bug I spotted in `orderTotal`: tax is computed on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Fixed.** `orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.

Changed one line so tax applies to `discounted`, not `cents`.
